description: This file defines the abstract class AbstractSerializer which provides base functionality for serializing and deserializing HTTP request and response messages, including methods for reading lines from a stream, splitting headers and body, and serializing headers. It contains constants for CRLF sequences and utility methods for stream parsing and header formatting.

classes.name: AbstractSerializer
classes.description: Provides base functionality for request and response de/serialization strategies, including retrieving lines, splitting headers, and serializing headers.

methods.name: getLine
methods.description: Reads a line from the stream, handling CRLF sequences and throwing exceptions for unexpected characters or end of headers.

methods.name: splitStream
methods.description: Splits a stream into headers and body, returning an array with headers and a stream for the body content.

methods.name: serializeHeaders
methods.description: Converts headers array into a serialized string suitable for HTTP transmission.

methods.name: filterHeader
methods.description: Converts a header name into a wordcase format with proper capitalization and hyphenation.
